{{Quote|No, I was just coming down here to get some caf. Chances are, it's the last we'll have once we set down on Garqi. They grow plenty of the beans there, but never mastered the art of brewing it. At least, that was true two decades ago.|Corran Horn|<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin]]''</ref>}}
The '''caf bean''' was grown on a [[Plant/Legends|plant]] native to [[Garqi/Legends|Garqi]], an [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] in the [[Cassander sector/Legends|Cassander sector]]. The [[Seed/Legends|bean]] grew plentifully on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]], and was harvested and exported to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] as a luxury foodstuff; this cultivation was particularly encouraged following the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] annexation of the Cassander [[Sector/Legends|sector]] shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The Garqi caf beans produced gourmet-quality [[Caf/Legends|caf]],<ref name="Geo" /> a bitter, caffeinated beverage brewed with hot [[Water/Legends|water]]<ref name="Crosscurrent">''[[Crosscurrent]]''</ref> and ground beans.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|104}}</ref> According to the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]],<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin" /> who spent some time on the planet in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]],<ref name="Missed">{{JournalCite|7|Missed Chance}}</ref> the [[Garqian]]s never mastered the art of brewing caf beans into decent caf,<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin" /> despite hosting numerous [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcafes]].<ref name="Missed" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Author/Legends|Author]] [[Michael A. Stackpole|Michael Stackpole]] created caf beans for his novel ''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin]]'', published by [[Del Rey]] in [[2000]]; however, he had previously mentioned the drink caf in several of his other novels.<ref name="Novels">See, for example, ''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]'', ''[[X-Wing: The Krytos Trap]]'', and ''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''.</ref> The Garqi caf beans were later mentioned in [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]'', published in [[2004]].
